serverInfo.name: There's An AI For That
serverInfo.title: There's An AI For That
serverInfo.description: Search and discover AI tools, deals, MCP servers, news, breakthroughs, and catalog entities on There's An AI For That.

initialize_result.instructions: Use search_tools for AI products and get_tool for details about one AI product. Use search_deals to find TAAFT partner offers and get_deal for one offer. Use search_news/get_news for AI news, and search_breakthroughs/get_breakthrough for news marked as AI breakthroughs. For other catalog entities, use the matching search and detail pair: search_tasks/get_task, search_models/get_model, search_companies/get_company, search_robots/get_robot, search_devices/get_device, search_organizations/get_organization, search_investors/get_investor, search_countries/get_country, search_events/get_event, search_fundraises/get_fundraise, search_papers/get_paper, or search_repositories/get_repository. Use search_mcps and get_mcp for MCP servers. Also use search_mcps when an MCP server would be relevant to the requested task, even if the user did not explicitly mention MCP. Use list_features to browse every TAAFT feature, then list_feature_tools or list_feature_models to list everything on one feature in feature page order; these are complete listings, not searches. Recommend only returned records and preserve their URLs exactly.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search tools
tools.description: Search the TAAFT directory for AI tools that match a query. Each result includes deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists. Use url for TAAFT pages and website_url for external websites. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

query.description: What the user needs an AI tool for.

website_url.description: TAAFT redirect to the external website. Preserve this URL exactly when sharing it.

expires_at.description: Explicit expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when no reliable date is present.

description_trial_days.description: Trial length in days extracted from deal description text, when present.

is_lifetime_plan.description: True when the description mentions lifetime access or one-time purchase.

raw_text.description: Deal-related text copied from the tool description when present.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get tool details
tools.description: Get public details for one TAAFT AI tool by slug, including deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists. Use url for the TAAFT page and website_url for the external website. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

slug.description: The tool slug returned by search_tools.

expires_at.description: Explicit expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when no reliable date is present.

description_trial_days.description: Trial length in days extracted from deal description text, when present.

is_lifetime_plan.description: True when the description mentions lifetime access or one-time purchase.

raw_text.description: Deal-related text copied from the tool description when present.

task.description: Optional task name or task slug.

limit.description: Optional result cap. Omit it to list every matching deal.

expires_at.description: Explicit expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when no reliable date is present.

description_trial_days.description: Trial length in days extracted from deal description text, when present.

is_lifetime_plan.description: True when the description mentions lifetime access or one-time purchase.

raw_text.description: Deal-related text copied from the tool description when present.

tools.name: list_features
tools.title: List features
tools.description: List every TAAFT feature with its id, name, slug, TAAFT URL, tool count, and model count. This is a complete alphabetical listing, not a search: there is no query and no relevance ranking. Call it with no arguments to list everything. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

limit.description: Optional page size. Omit it to list every feature.

tools.name: list_feature_tools
tools.title: List feature tools
tools.description: List every AI tool on one TAAFT feature, in the same order as the feature page. This is a complete listing, not a search: no query, no relevance ranking, nothing missing and nothing extra. Each tool carries the full get_tool fields, including deal details when an approved TAAFT partner offer exists. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

feature.description: Feature id, feature slug, or exact feature name as returned by list_features.

offset.description: Number of tools to skip, in feature page order.

limit.description: Page size. Keep calling with next_offset until has_more is false to get the complete listing.

expires_at.description: Explicit expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null when no reliable date is present.

description_trial_days.description: Trial length in days extracted from deal description text, when present.

is_lifetime_plan.description: True when the description mentions lifetime access or one-time purchase.

raw_text.description: Deal-related text copied from the tool description when present.

tools.name: list_feature_models
tools.title: List feature models
tools.description: List every AI model on one TAAFT feature, in the same order as the feature page. This is a complete listing, not a search: no query, no relevance ranking, nothing missing and nothing extra. Each model carries the full get_model fields. Preserve returned URLs exactly.

feature.description: Feature id, feature slug, or exact feature name as returned by list_features.

offset.description: Number of models to skip, in feature page order.

limit.description: Page size. Keep calling with next_offset until has_more is false to get the complete listing.
